## What

The full data path with replayed frames:

```
loader -> ARM -> fabric (AXI DMA) -> DDR -> storage
```

## Done when

- [ ] A 2-minute pass at the budgeted rate with **zero drops**.
- [ ] Checksums match end to end.
- [ ] DDR buffer size and storage write rate recorded, with margin against the
      B1.2 budget.

## Notes

Replaces `MEM-01` to `MEM-03` (DDR3 controller, arbiter, cube addressing),
`ST-01`/`ST-02` (SD writer) and `V-04` (DDR and SD models). On the K26 the PS
owns DDR and Linux owns storage; the fabric only needs AXI DMA.
